title: V2 rocket goes off course into Mexico as a warning

tellings.quote: Next thing you know, a V2 rocket goes off course and hits a a place in Mexico.

plain: In the late 1940s a V2, the long-range rocket Nazi Germany built during the Second World War, went off course and came down on a place in Mexico, and it was meant as a warning. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this without naming a source. If true, it would mean the stray rocket was a message, not an accident.
